notes:
Shanghai Stock Exchange main-board issuer, code 603061 (cover page); the 公司信息 block on physical p6 gives the legal Chinese name 天津金海通半导体设备股份有限公司, short name 金海通 and foreign name JHT Design Co.,Ltd. / JHT. Business scope as the filing states it: R&D, manufacture and sale of integrated-circuit 测试分选机 (test handlers) only, sold with spare parts; series EXCEED-6000/-8000/-9000, SUMMIT and COLLIE, plus accessories. Customers are OSATs, test foundries, IDMs and fabless designers. What it does NOT cover: the issuer makes no testers (测试机), no probers (探针台), no probe cards and no front-end equipment. It states no memory, KGD or HBM product: p14 says only that it continues to watch demand for a Memory handler platform on the basis of existing technology reserves. Five minority equity stakes (华芯智能 wafer-level sorter/IGBT KGD sorter, 猎奇智能, 芯诣电子 burn-in, 鑫益邦 die bonders, 瑞玛思特 RF test) are investments, not consolidated product lines, and must not be attributed to this entity.

UNEVIDENCED ALIASES. These aliases occur in no source this atlas holds: 'Tianjin Jinhaitong Semiconductor Equipment'; 'Tianjin Jinhaitong Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd.'. They are kept because they are useful search handles -- a romanisation, an English rendering of a Chinese or Korean legal name, or a ticker written with an exchange suffix -- but nothing in this repository evidences them, so none should be quoted as the company's own name or used to match a record in another dataset. `python3 -m atlas verify-aliases` reports the current list; an alias that later turns up in an acquired filing should be moved out of this note. Every other alias on this record was found in a held source.
